Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity records in assay CHEMBL1613797. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter to exact activity values where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
